definitions.explanation: Dropping digits below a certain decimal place rather than rounding up. A mathematical and financial term.
Eliminating something deemed unnecessary or unwanted, sometimes ruthlessly.

examples.japanese: {小数点以下|しょうすうてんいか}を{切|き}り{捨|す}てる。
examples.english: To round down the decimal places.

examples.japanese: {消費税|しょうひぜい}の{計算|けいさん}では{一円未満|いちえんみまん}を{切|き}り{捨|す}てにする。
examples.english: In sales tax calculations, amounts less than one yen are rounded down.

examples.japanese: この{表計算|ひょうけいさん}ソフトでは、{切|き}り{捨|す}て・{切|き}り{上|あ}げ・{四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}が{選|えら}べる。
examples.english: In this spreadsheet software, you can choose between rounding down, rounding up, or standard rounding.

examples.japanese: {弱者|じゃくしゃ}の{切|き}り{捨|す}ては{許|ゆる}されない。
{不採算|ふさいさん}{部門|ぶもん}の{切|き}り{捨|す}てを{検討|けんとう}している。
examples.english: They are considering cutting unprofitable divisions.

examples.japanese: {地方|ちほう}の{切|き}り{捨|す}てにつながる{政策|せいさく}だと{批判|ひはん}されている。
examples.english: The policy is criticized as leading to the abandonment of rural areas.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {切|き}り{捨|す}てる (to cut off and discard). Has both a technical mathematical meaning and a figurative meaning of ruthlessly discarding.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{捨|す}てにする: to round down; to discard
- {小数点以下|しょうすうてんいか}{切|き}り{捨|す}て: truncation below the decimal point
- {弱者|じゃくしゃ}の{切|き}り{捨|す}て: abandoning the weak

RELATED WORDS:
- {切|き}り{上|あ}げ: rounding up — the opposite operation
- {四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}: standard rounding (round 4 and below down, 5 and above up)

ETYMOLOGY:
{切|き}り{捨|す}て{御免|ごめん} was the historical right of samurai to kill commoners who showed disrespect, literally "cut down and pardon."
